title: Why we assess before we recommend anything
summary: A look inside a consultation, and why it takes longer than most first appointments.
body:
Most first appointments in medical aesthetics move quickly toward a recommendation. At Dr Tranter Aesthetics, the first appointment is entirely assessment, no treatment is proposed in the same visit it is first discussed.

This is deliberate. A recommendation made before assessment is a guess dressed as advice. The clinic's approach separates the two, so that whatever is proposed afterward has a clear, explainable reason behind it.

In practice, this means most new patients leave their first visit without a booking, but with a clear written plan and an understanding of why each option was or wasn’t suggested. The second appointment is where that plan is actually put into action.
